==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A hostile Alien Meteor Dinosaur approached the village. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Alien Meteor Dinosaurs resemble very large alien dinosaurs with spiky triangle shaped heads and rocky scaly hides.)
I tamed it using my geomancy and rode around on top of its head.
Using my Lucid Light I created my own private castle inside of its body. (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
